node.title: DSP8 nodal decoration class-discount no-go
node.statement: Over F_769 with the order-256 subgroup, an explicit signed-disjoint pair of singular product-one triples has all nine decorations nonidentity, P>=72 and R>=79, while seven decorations are antipodal. Thus no row-independent 4/9, 5/9, or 2/3 antipodal class discount follows from nodality, decoration, signed disjointness, richness, and quotient support alone. Since 769<256^2, this is a route fence and not an official-row or DSP8 counterexample; a surviving class discount must genuinely use official field size or cross-target arithmetic.
